16. 圖中，半圓 ABC 的直徑為 3 cm。若 AC = 2 cm，求陰影區域的面積準確至最接近的 0.01 cm²。
A. 0.23 cm²
B. 0.52 cm²
C. 0.64 cm²
D. 1.07 cm²
reasoning: The diameter of the semicircle is 3 cm, so the radius r = 1.5 cm. The chord AC has length 2 cm. For a chord of length L in a circle of radius r, the central angle θ satisfies L = 2r·sin(θ/2). Thus sin(θ/2) = 2/(2·1.5) = 2/3, giving θ = 2·arcsin(2/3) ≈ 1.4595 rad. The area of the circular segment (the region bounded by chord AC and the arc AC) is given by (r²/2)·(θ – sin θ). With r² = 2.25, the segment area = 1.125·(θ – sin θ) ≈ 1.125·(1.4595 – 0.9938) ≈ 0.5239 cm². Rounded to the nearest 0.01 cm² this is 0.52 cm², which corresponds to choice B.
